in_telugu.long_meaning: లవంశ - దేశ - desh (land), ఎక - ఒన్నేది (one), అయ్యప్పోయిన - ayyappoyinu (descendant)

in_marathi.name: Ekalavansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekalavansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Refers to a person belonging to a single lineage or dynasty. The name Ekalavansh is derived from the words 'eka' meaning 'one' and 'lavansh' meaning 'lineage'. This name holds a significant place in Indian mythology, particularly in the epic Mahabharata.
